subject.title: Improve doctor/gateway diagnostics clarity for mixed LaunchAgent/runtime states

question: Should `openclaw doctor` grow a composed final gateway diagnosis that combines RPC health, LaunchAgent/service runtime, service-config drift, port/client clues, and channel conflict hints, and should that model expose machine-readable diagnosis output?
rationale: Current main collects most of the underlying facts, but the state taxonomy, cause precedence, action ordering, and JSON shape are stable operator-facing CLI decisions that automation should not invent.

options.title: Add Composed Doctor Verdict
options.body: Render one final healthy/degraded/down-style diagnosis with probable causes and ordered recovery steps while reusing existing doctor, gateway, service, and channel facts.

options.title: Share Status-All First
options.body: Extract the existing `status --all` diagnosis inputs into a shared read-only model before changing doctor output.

options.title: Tune Panels Only
options.body: Keep the current independent doctor panels and improve copy only after a live mixed-state transcript narrows the confusing output.

recommendation.title: Add Composed Doctor Verdict
recommendation.body: Render one final healthy/degraded/down-style diagnosis with probable causes and ordered recovery steps while reusing existing doctor, gateway, service, and channel facts.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses doctor, gateway probe, LaunchAgent/runtime, and status-all diagnostic surfaces where steipete has the strongest history signal.
